import numpy as np
# steady loads in W
m=1000; cp=3600 # J/kgK
# components: transmission, infiltration/door, respiration, fan+controls, safety
U=0.35 # W/m2K with 100mm PU
A=30 # m2 chamber surface
dT=38 # 43 ambient -5 room
Q_trans=U*A*dT
Q_resp=0.06*m # 60 mW/kg mixed veg at 5C
Q_door=120 # avg with strip curtain, ~10 openings/day
Q_fan=60
Q_total=Q_trans+Q_resp+Q_door+Q_fan
print(f"Q_trans={Q_trans:.0f} W Q_resp={Q_resp:.0f} W Q_door={Q_door:.0f} W Q_fan={Q_fan:.0f} W Q_total={Q_total:.0f} W")
# pull-down: 250 kg/day fresh at 30C cooled to 5C + steady load, cooling capacity 800W, COP reflected as electrical later
C_produce=m*cp # J/K full tonne
# simple lumped: dT/dt = (Q_load - Q_cool)/C
Q_cool=800
Q_steady=Q_total
T0=30; Tset=5; dt=600
T=T0; t=0; times=[]; temps=[]
for i in range(200):
    Q_net = Q_steady - Q_cool # negative = cooling
    # respiration drops as cools: scale roughly
    T = T + Q_net*dt/C_produce
    t+=dt
    times.append(t/3600); temps.append(T)
    if T<=Tset: break
print(f"pull-down full tonne to 5C in {t/3600:.1f} h at 800 W net")
print(f"daily pull-down energy 250kg batch kWh={(250*cp*25/3.6e6):.2f}")
print(f"steady daily kWh={(Q_total*24/1000):.2f}")
